summary.headline: Planetary Indications of Professions
summary.text: Astrological delineations of professions and activities from planetary positions, signs, houses, terms, aspects, and lunar applications, including sailors, hunters, doctors, athletes, gardeners, fishermen, philosophers, orators, astrologers, and herb-gatherers. The page then begins a discussion of the stars’ spear-bearing to the lights, with Saturn’s influence on the Sun.
